decision.summary: target-b has high route_error_rate (0.9681) and high p95_s (1.635s) despite container_state=running and ready=true. target-a is healthy with error_rate=0.0 and p95_s=0.04s. Config and state are identical between targets. The error rate suggests the tool-call parser or chat template is malfunctioning on target-b, causing most requests to fail.

repair_plan.expected_effect: Restart target-b with its current profile, which should resolve the tool-call parsing failure causing the 96.8% error rate.
repair_plan.risk: Low - restarting a single worker; other worker (target-a) continues serving. Requires rollback via undrain-worker if issue persists.
verification_plan: Run tool-call-visible probe on target-b to confirm structured tool call succeeds.
Run route-probe on target-b to confirm error_rate drops below max_error_rate threshold and p95_s below max_p95_s threshold.
Confirm target-b ok flag returns to true.
repair_plan.rollback_plan: If error_rate remains high after restart, use undrain-worker (action_id: undrain-worker) to return target-b to rotation, then investigate further.
